courses.name: Lightbox CT: Acute Medical and Surgical Interpretation Essentials

courses.notes: Commercial radiology and ultrasound education provider (Noosaville QLD). Hands-on ultrasound-guided vascular access workshop. Fees on the course page.

courses.name: Lightbox Ultrasound: Point of Care (PoCUS, one day)
courses.notes: Commercial radiology and ultrasound education provider (Noosaville QLD). Foundational point-of-care ultrasound skills. Fees on the course page.
